design_description: Best combination in this test panel of a high sequence score and a stable preferred contact face. Exact HER2 footprint in five of six models.
The contact-preserving half of the main experiment. Five substitutions and sequence score 32, the same as anas_009. All four contacts in six of six.
The other half of the same experiment. The same four building blocks are present, but none of the six models has all four contacts at once.
Challenger from a different design method. Only two of the four original amino acids are kept, yet all four positions make contact in six of six. Exact footprint in three of six.
Highest sequence score of the twenty. Only three of six models have all four contacts, so the first reserve tests the strongest sequence-based hypothesis.
Sequence score 38 and all four contacts in six of six. A stronger overall case for early testing than the previous number six, anas_027.
Same sequence score as anas_003, but greater mean overlap with the whole HER2 footprint. Three exact footprints, although no pose has all four loop contacts.
Keeps all four contacts across six model runs. At the same sequence score as anas_038, its overall HER2 footprint is less like the original's.
Best mean overlap in the group scoring 35. All four contacts in six of six. Comparable to anas_021, which also carries four substitutions.
Same sequence score, and the same number of runs with all contacts, as anas_002. A slightly greater mean overlap gives it a narrow priority.
Same sequence score as the two above it, and six of six with all four contacts. Somewhat lower mean overlap.
Lowest mean overlap of the candidates scoring 35. Gives an extra comparison pair with anas_004 if both reach the lab.
Sequence score 32 places it ahead of the candidates scoring 31 under this rule. Only two of six keep all the contacts. Its priority over anas_014 is especially uncertain.
Very high overlap with the whole HER2 footprint, six of six with all four contacts, and three exact footprints. First of the two scoring 31.
Same sequence score, and the same six of six loop contacts, as anas_014, but lower overlap with the whole HER2 footprint.
Greatest mean overlap among the four scoring 30. Keeps all four contacts in six of six.
Second greatest mean overlap among the candidates scoring 30. All four contacts in six of six. The difference from anas_031 is small.
Third highest mean overlap in the group scoring 30. Four of six have all the loop contacts. Its placing against anas_032 depends on which property you weight.
novel2: strongest independent monomer fold; docking unsupported
novel3: strongest Mol1 epitope-recovery hypothesis across two target contexts; large CDRH3 uncertainty
